name: mhrshopping
description: MehrShopping - full-stack Persian/English e-commerce platform (API + web storefront)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @mhr/api & npm run dev -w @mhr/web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mhr/api && npm run build -w @mhr/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mhr/api && npm run test -w @mhr/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mhr/api && npm run lint -w @mhr/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mhr/api && npm run typecheck -w @mhr/web
